steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: Every job keeps its own photos. Here is where to find them on a project.

steps.caption: Open the project
steps.narration: Open the job from the Pipeline. We'll use the Kane job.

steps.caption: This job's shots
steps.narration: These are this job's shots, newest first.

steps.caption: Open feed
steps.narration: Open feed gives the job's photos a page of their own.

steps.caption: Search and filters
steps.narration: Search and filter here, the same way as in the main JobCam feed.

steps.caption: Timeline
steps.narration: Timeline groups this job's shots by day.

steps.caption: Share
steps.narration: Share is for sending this job's photos to someone as a link.

steps.caption: Open camera
steps.narration: Open camera is where new shots for this job are taken.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: Open any job from Pipeline, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find a job's photos on its project | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the JobCam tab on a project in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a job, see its photos, open the job's own photo page, and switch between the grid and the timeline.
